title: PixelKin - Stillwater (SNES register)
_note: Stillwater, the Hollowing's village (11-the-hollowing-country.md Part A): shuttered lamps, soft voices, sleeping kin. A HUSH-HYMN, a music-box with a felt damper. 72 BPM, 3/4, D minor. Quotes the VESPER MOTIF (lift A3-D4-E4, settle F4-E4-D4) the Hollowing way: in A the settle never lands (bars 4 and 8 hang on E over a suspended A, the 'guttering' rule for the Hollowing's zones); A' climbs a step higher and falls back to C#; B turns to Bb major, the hall's hymn (what they believe: a gentle, sung rest) and only there does the line touch D before hanging on E again to lead home. SNES register kept muted: a quiet pulse25 lead, a BELL music-box doubling the downbeats at low gain (the felt damper), a strings hymn pad, a pluck that only breathes in B, tri_bass roots. No drums. 24 bars, 60 s. Original (VISION.md).
